text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look look!
Don't I look completely unbeatable today?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I had the day off, so I went to a spa,
and it was seriously soo amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There were flower petals floating in the bath,
and the spa treatment felt ridiculously good!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I seriously recommend it, so why don't you check it out, Trainer?
Wanna take today off and go right now?

Making the most of her day off,
Tosen Jordan seems to have rested up completely!
